planned_by: Claude (Critic): SEC-02, blocks any public/BYOK use
goal:
T68 / SEC-02 — candidate code leaves the API container. Today the API runs Builder output itself (pipeline
scoring, Arena lanes, evolution rounds, preview() renders, and the judge's/Critic's model-written tests); the API holds
secrets and can reach the metadata server. When a Runner is configured (EVO_RUNNER_URL; services/runner/app.py, no
secrets, no roles) all of that must run there. Ownership note: services/runner/app.py is Codex's module; keep its
existing /run behaviour and tests intact (backward compatible additions only) and say so in your tests.

Runner (services/runner/app.py), POST /run additions (optional fields, defaults keep today's reply exactly):
- failures: bool = False -> heldout gets "failures": [{"test": <failing test id/name from the JUnit report>,
  "message": <first line of the failure, at most 300 chars>}] (no test code).
- preview_module: str = "" (a Python identifier, else 400) -> after the tests, run preview() of that module in the
  sandbox in a fresh `python -I` subprocess with the Runner's env allowlist, 10 s timeout, stdout capped at 65536 bytes;
  reply "preview": {"html": str | None, "error": str | None} (error mentions "timeout" / "too large" / the exception).
API:
- services/api/evoforge/runner_client.py: run_files(files: dict[path, text], sealed_tests: list[{code}], timeout_s=120,
  preview_module=None) -> {"heldout": {pass, n, timed_out, exit_code, report_integrity, failures}, "preview": {...} or
  None}. It builds a throw-away git repo holding exactly these files (server-created, trusted), bundles it like
  run_via_runner (_create_bundle), POSTs /run with diff "" and failures=True, validates the reply as run_via_runner does
  (base match, counts, kinds) and raises RunnerClientError / RunnerBadRequest / RunnerTooLarge on problems.
- Routing when runner_client.runner_url() is set — every execution of candidate or model-written code goes through
  run_files: sealed_eval._run_heldout_local / _run_heldout_local_detail when scoring candidates (read the sandbox's
  files, skipping .git), arena._score_heldout_counted, evolution_rounds._score_files_counted, the preview renders in
  arena.py and evolution_rounds.py (use preview_module), and arena_prompt.py's judge-test filtering on the template /
  starting files. Convert replies to the existing return shapes (including failure names for retry feedback) and keep
  sealed_eval._heldout_result_is_consistent checks. Suite validation of trusted Critic data (check_task /
  load_suites) may stay local. Fail closed: a Runner error is a lane/round error or SealedEvalError — never a local
  fallback, never a READY/passed result.
- Without a Runner URL everything behaves exactly as today (dev and tests).
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t68.py (load the Runner app in-process like test_critic_t16_runner_service.py).
